story

I learn by building. Java lets me explore how software works behind the scenes; SwiftUI lets me explore how it feels to use.

Carbon Footprint explores Java and React together. Wyndra and Glassora explore native SwiftUI interfaces. These are separate applications: the iOS projects do not use Carbon Footprint’s Java backend.

This portfolio follows the same practical approach: its terminal works locally, with no AI account or network request. Try “projects”, “arch” or “oss” for the details.
